request: Always open and parse parent .gitignore and .git/info/exclude files above the nearest Git boundary, even if their rules will not apply, so --debug shows our entire ancestor configuration.

source.request: Always open and parse parent .gitignore and .git/info/exclude files above the nearest Git boundary, even if their rules will not apply, so --debug shows our entire ancestor configuration.
source.settled: Parent loading skips Git-specific ignore files above the nearest repository boundary while continuing to read general ignore files.
source.why: Opening those files restores the unnecessary ancestor reads the ticket explicitly eliminated.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored. Also accepts ticket N (a space), any case, with an optional #.
